programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The first make HK$1 million at the local box office, Chang Cheh's Wuxia film sparked a new age in martial arts films with its male anti-heroes and violence.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: A clash of cultures and such ensue after Mr. Funny Bone and Big Potato open an old-fashioned healing clinic in ultra-modern Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: After taking a magic pill, a swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night. To make it worse, she has to run after she ruins the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan
programme.desc: A young woman joins the army in place of her old, ailing father and only when she returns home is the truth revealed.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home when they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek

programme.title: Heads for Sale

programme.title: Na Cha and the Seven Devils

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes

programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1 Ep1
programme.desc: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1 Ep2
programme.desc: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati's territory and its neighboring fruit trees.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1 Ep3
programme.desc: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1 Ep4
programme.desc: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1 Ep5
programme.desc: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, to face a challenge like none before.

programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes.

programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africa's wild animals.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Learn how South America's rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S2 Ep7

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S2 Ep8
programme.desc: The Pacific coast of Costa Rica is a biodiversity hotspot that hosts nearly 5,000 species of marine life. But here in this undersea jungle, the ocean's top predator is at risk.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered 'pests.' But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they're not welcome.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep5
programme.desc: There's strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3 Ep5
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3 Ep6
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1 Ep1

programme.title: Shadowlands S1 Ep2
programme.desc: In southwestern New Zealand, deep fiords and tidal lagoons are wrapped in green rainforest. The dark fjords harbor creatures normally found in the deep.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1 Ep3
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world - the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults.

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: The Soul of Los Angeles
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds hits restaurants inspired by heritage, including Cobi’s - where maximalism meets Southeast Asian, the California comfort food of Alta Adams and Yangban Society’s colorful Korean-American deli concept. Plus the best tacos in LA.

programme.title: LA's Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds spins through his hometown of L.A. visiting Chifa, a fashion-infused Peruvian/Chinese restaurant, authentic Mexican at La Casita Mexicana and Motherwolf - Evan Funke’s opulent Roman spot. Plus art galleries, shopping and burgers.

programme.title: Taking a Big Bite out of Boston
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds explores heritage-inspired spots in Boston including La Royal, dinner party-inspired Peruvian seafood restaurant, handmade German goodness at Bronwyn and over-the-top tiki culture at Wusong Road; plus the best oysters in town.

programme.title: No Sleep Til Brooklyn
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds gets neighborhood goodness at Bonnie's, a truly original Cantonese American concept, mind-blowing plant-based bites and retail at Aunts Et Uncles, and chophouse revival at Gage & Tollner. Plus art galleries, shopping and best pizza.

programme.title: Leveling Up in New York City
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds explores cutting edge concepts in NYC including Michelin star-winning Contra and Wildair, Madame Vo, a Vietnamese restaurant inspired by powerful women and Dhamaka an explosive Indian eatery. Plus shopping, art and best sandwiches.

programme.title: Melting Pot of Culture
programme.desc: India is known for its diversity of people who have come from far away lands to make it their home. In this episode we meet expats and early settlers of India like the Persians and find out from them what keeps them in India.

programme.title: Music & Indo-Chinese
programme.desc: Music is ingrained deep into the roots of India with each region boasting of its own unique flair. Shrim meets local musicians who boast about their music while eating something all Indians love: Indo Chinese food.

programme.title: Beauty & Chaats
programme.desc: Chaat is a typical Indian food that has become its own cuisine in India. In this episode we will meet some famous actors who show us their favourite chaats while talking about the beauty industry in India.

programme.title: Start-ups & Lunch On The Go
programme.desc: From Pole dancing to Ed-Tech to Sustainable fashion, we explore the unique world of start-ups in India while discovering what they eat everyday for lunch.

programme.title: Love & Home Food
programme.desc: India is famously known for its arranged marriages, but when there are 1.4 billion people there are so many possibilities. This episode is all about love and the best kind of food - Home Food.

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Spooky Halloween Party Bakes
programme.desc: Make your Halloween Party the talk of every boy and ghoul in the neighborhood! Whether it's the poisoned apples, the drippy candle cakes, coffin pies or savory treats (or tricks) – these delicious bakes will surely delight and scare.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: The Soul of Los Angeles
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds hits restaurants inspired by heritage, including Cobi’s - where maximalism meets Southeast Asian, the California comfort food of Alta Adams and Yangban Society’s colorful Korean-American deli concept. Plus the best tacos in LA.

programme.title: LA's Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds spins through his hometown of L.A. visiting Chifa, a fashion-infused Peruvian/Chinese restaurant, authentic Mexican at La Casita Mexicana and Motherwolf - Evan Funke’s opulent Roman spot. Plus art galleries, shopping and burgers.

programme.title: Taking a Big Bite out of Boston
programme.desc: Ben Hundreds explores heritage-inspired spots in Boston including La Royal, dinner party-inspired Peruvian seafood restaurant, handmade German goodness at Bronwyn and over-the-top tiki culture at Wusong Road; plus the best oysters in town.

programme.title: Wasabi & Strawberry Cheesecake
programme.desc: Tastemaker Emmy Cho travels to Shizuoka and Yokohama to discover the secrets of Kit Kat's Wasabi and Strawberry Cheesecake flavors.

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Shichimi 7 Spice Blend & Rum Raisin
programme.desc: In Nagano, Emmy heads to a shichimi pepper farm and a 300-year-old spice shop to learn the history of the 7 spice blend. Later, Emmy tries Tokyo's popular treats to find out how rum raisin gained such prominence in the area.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is making Steakhouse classics for his main meal; for his solo meal he’s putting his own twist on a traditional eggs benedict. His mystery meal will of course be a surprise but will hopefully win over even the pickiest parentals.

programme.title: Over the Top Holiday Cakes
programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays
programme.desc: In this episode, you don’t even need to turn on your oven! From a jaw-dropping cake hack, to fried biscuit donuts, you won’t believe what you can do with pre-made desserts from the supermarket. Mia will show hacks and great tips for any home-baker!

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Spooky Halloween Party Bakes
programme.desc: Make your Halloween Party the talk of every boy and ghoul in the neighborhood! Whether it's the poisoned apples, the drippy candle cakes, coffin pies or savory treats (or tricks) – these delicious bakes will surely delight and scare.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: It's Taco Time
programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale’s heart, and to prove it, he’s grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
programme.desc: Grilling isn’t only about fast and casual dinners. Chef Dale grills to impress with this elegant, restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: The Chicken Episode
programme.desc: If you’re going to grill chicken, you’ll want to make it good. Chef Dale likes to kick up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

programme.title: Brunch On The Grill
programme.desc: Wake up, it’s time to grill! Chef Dale greets the day with a showstopping dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with creme fraiche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: Vegetables, But Delicious
programme.desc: Grilling is the perfect way to imbue your veggies with deliciousness. Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.title: Kabobs and Skewers
programme.desc: Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale. This Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Pearls in Palawan
programme.desc: Erwan travels to the gorgeous island of Palawan where he meets with the locals and learns about pearl farming.

programme.title: Octopus in Isabela
programme.desc: In this episode, Erwan travels to the remote area of Palanan in Isabela, where he meets the Dumagat tribe and learns how to catch an octopus the traditional way.

programme.title: Mud Crab in Dumaguete
programme.desc: Erwan learned how to catch crustaceans while growing up, but in Dumaguete, he discovers their unique regional approach to catching mud crabs.

programme.title: Rainbow Runner in Apo Island
programme.desc: Apo Island is famous for its marine Sanctuary. Erwan meets environmentalists and learns about the Rainbow Runner fish.

programme.title: Fruit Bat in Mindoro
programme.desc: On the island of Mindoro, Erwan samples a traditional Filipino Adobo, made with an unlikely source of protein - locally caught fruit bats.

programme.title: Flying Fish in Batanes
programme.desc: Batanes, known for its breathtaking coastline, is home to the mataw fishermen clan. With their guidance, Erwan sets out to catch dorado by using flying fish as bait.

programme.title: Smoked Pork in Sagada
programme.desc: In the mountainous region of Sagada, Erwan sets out to find out more about a local favorite smoked pork: Etag. Along the way, he meets a French chef, an Etag producer, and a local cook who teaches him about indigenous Igorot dishes.

programme.title: World's Smallest Edible Fish in Bicol
programme.desc: Known as the tiniest edible fish in the world, sinarapan are found in the many lakes covering the Bicol region. We follow Erwan as he attempts to catch these minuscule fish and see the many ways they can be prepared.

programme.desc: There’s no such thing as too much cheese, especially for these creators as they attempt record-setting cheese pulls and unique spins on the sensational feta pasta. Whose culinary creation will melt the internet?!

programme.title: Can You Hack It
programme.desc: Competitors push the creative limits of the well-known wrap hack, then aim to impress the judges by elevating another internet favorite in pasta pies. You may know these viral hacks well, but you’ve never seen them done quite like this.

programme.title: Snack Attack
programme.desc: The creators are challenged to shrink the internet’s favorite grubby meals down to miniature perfection and blow them up to gargantuan greatness. But size isn’t the only thing that matters to the judges, they’re looking for flawless flavor.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: The creators show off their best holiday handiwork in the kitchen, cranking out seasonal stuffed waffles and hot chocolate bomb-inspired desserts to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year.

programme.title: Farmer's Market Finds
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith heads to the Farmers Market for the first time. Inspired by rows of fresh fruit, veggies and the local farmers he creates a flavorful meal like Veggie Focaccia, Mushroom Medley Pasta, Spiced Apple Cobbler and a crisp white Sangria.

programme.title: A South Carolina Family Reunion
programme.desc: For his reunion inspired menu Chef Derrell Smith is going back to his roots. Cookin’ up some modern takes on the family classics including his Garlic Pesto Potato Salad, Salmon Filet, a Herby, Spicy Kale Slaw, and Grilled Fruit Skewers.

programme.title: Happy Birthday to Me
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s birthday and he’s treating himself to some self love and a lavish steak dinner inspired by a famous NYC steakhouse. On the menu: Rib Eye Steak with Peppercorn Sauce, Duck Frites, Wedge Salad and a celebratory carrot cake.

programme.title: Grandma Estelle
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s grandma inspired him in life and in the kitchen. He shares family recipes taking him right back to grandma's table. He's cookin' up Fried Chicken, Mac ‘N Cheese, Collard Green Slaw, Brûlée Banana Pudding and Pop-pops moonshine.

programme.title: Hotdishes

programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted…

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: PART 2
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. The Eiffel Tower is shredded by violent winds. Mount Rushmore crumbles under hurricane-level pressure. The Great Pyramids are reduced to pile of rubble as black funnels snake across the desert. Unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents And when a bizarre plague of frogs terrorizes New York’s Museum of Natural History, religious zealots compete with scientists for a rational explanation. For years, scientists have been expounding theories—and warnings—of global-warming effects. Finally someone is listening: Judith Carr (Gina Gershon, Face/Off), newly appointed head of FEMA. It’s disaster, Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E05 - Hunger Pains
programme.desc: Los síntomas de inanición se han apoderado de Chris y Casey, que llevan días sin comer. Cuando se cruzan con un urogallo, ocurre lo inesperado. La frustración aumenta a medida que bajan las temperaturas. Los hermanos montan un nuevo campamento, pero ¿ayudará a la caza?

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E06 - White Out
programme.desc: Sin caza mayor a la vista, Chris y Casey se ven obligados a depender de la pesca para alimentarse. Las bajas temperaturas han ralentizado a los peces, creando desafíos. Cuando la madre naturaleza trae una brutal tormenta de nieve, los hermanos se ponen a prueba como nunca antes.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E07 - Motherly Love
programme.desc: Tras semanas intentando sobrevivir en Saskatchewan, Chris y Casey aún no han matado ningún animal de caza mayor. El tiempo se agota a medida que los osos empiezan a hibernar. La fuerza de voluntad mental se agota. Pero un mensaje de vuelta a casa lo cambia todo.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E08 - Refuelled
programme.desc: Un giro en los acontecimientos levanta el ánimo de los hermanos, pero crea un enorme obstáculo que deben superar a medida que se adentran en una nueva carrera contra el reloj.Chris y Casey reflexionan sobre los retos a los que se han enfrentado hasta ahora, y los desafíos que aún tienen por delante.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E04 - Wind
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas analiza el poder destructivo del viento. Desde el poder devastador del huracán Katrina en Nueva Orleans hasta el destructor ciclón Nargis en Myanmar, pasando por la tormenta de 1960, el huracán Donna en Florida, el tornado Joplin en Misuri y el huracán Sandy en Nueva York.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: El terror abrasador de un incendio puede equipararse a cualquier cosa de la creación en lo que a amenaza se refiere. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los incendios, como el del sábado negro en Victoria (Australia), el de la discoteca Station en Rhode Island, el de los grandes almacenes L'Innovation en Bruselas (Bélgica), el de la armería en Lagos (Nigeria) y el de la nueva zona de desarrollo de Binhai en Tianjin (China).

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: Cuando se rompe el dique, la cosa se pone fea.... Horas desesperadas repasa algunas de las inundaciones más devastadoras de la historia, como la de Río de Janeiro en Brasil, las de Luisiana en Estados Unidos, las de Hamburgo en Alemania, las de Uttarakhand en el norte de la India y el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: A veces, todo lo que se necesita es un movimiento bajo los pies.... Horas desesperadas examina las principales catástrofes geológicas, como las avalanchas de Afganistán, Pakistán, Nepal, Perú y Francia. También analiza desprendimientos geológicos en Filipinas, India y Colombia y un enorme socavón que consumió un estanque en Bosnia. También analiza las ventiscas en Estados Unidos, Israel y Reino Unido.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall
programme.desc: El cazador de ciervos Nathan Holcomb cae en picado desde su puesto en el árbol. La peor pesadilla de cualquier cazador se convierte en la realidad de Nathan. Con la espalda rota y paralizado, Nathan debe arrastrarse por su cuenta para encontrar ayuda.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: En lo que se considera una de las mayores historias de supervivencia del siglo XX, el marinero Steven Callahan se encuentra solo y a la deriva en una balsa salvavidas después de que su barco, el Napoleon Solo se hunda en pleno Atlántico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E10 - Adrift Part 2
programme.desc: Enfrentado al hambre, la deshidratación y los depredadores de las profundidades, el marinero Steven Callahan lucha por sobrevivir no sólo a las dificultades físicas, sino también a la tensión mental y emocional de estar a la deriva y solo en una balsa salvavidas que se desintegra.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E01 - Nightmare Canyon Part 1
programme.desc: El descenso de fin de semana de Justin y Jeremy Harris a un remoto cañón de Utah se convierte en una pesadilla de supervivencia cuando Justin se rompe gravemente una pierna. A medida que se acerca la noche y las temperaturas descienden por debajo del punto de congelación, ¿cómo sobrevivirán estos dos hermanos?

Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E05 - Hunger Pains
programme.desc: Los síntomas de inanición se han apoderado de Chris y Casey, que llevan días sin comer. Cuando se cruzan con un urogallo, ocurre lo inesperado. La frustración aumenta a medida que bajan las temperaturas. Los hermanos montan un nuevo campamento, pero ¿ayudará a la caza?

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E06 - White Out
programme.desc: Sin caza mayor a la vista, Chris y Casey se ven obligados a depender de la pesca para alimentarse. Las bajas temperaturas han ralentizado a los peces, creando desafíos. Cuando la madre naturaleza trae una brutal tormenta de nieve, los hermanos se ponen a prueba como nunca antes.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E07 - Motherly Love
programme.desc: Tras semanas intentando sobrevivir en Saskatchewan, Chris y Casey aún no han matado ningún animal de caza mayor. El tiempo se agota a medida que los osos empiezan a hibernar. La fuerza de voluntad mental se agota. Pero un mensaje de vuelta a casa lo cambia todo.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E08 - Refuelled
programme.desc: Un giro en los acontecimientos levanta el ánimo de los hermanos, pero crea un enorme obstáculo que deben superar a medida que se adentran en una nueva carrera contra el reloj.Chris y Casey reflexionan sobre los retos a los que se han enfrentado hasta ahora, y los desafíos que aún tienen por delante.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E04 - Wind
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas analiza el poder destructivo del viento. Desde el poder devastador del huracán Katrina en Nueva Orleans hasta el destructor ciclón Nargis en Myanmar, pasando por la tormenta de 1960, el huracán Donna en Florida, el tornado Joplin en Misuri y el huracán Sandy en Nueva York.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: El terror abrasador de un incendio puede equipararse a cualquier cosa de la creación en lo que a amenaza se refiere. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los incendios, como el del sábado negro en Victoria (Australia), el de la discoteca Station en Rhode Island, el de los grandes almacenes L'Innovation en Bruselas (Bélgica), el de la armería en Lagos (Nigeria) y el de la nueva zona de desarrollo de Binhai en Tianjin (China).

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: Cuando se rompe el dique, la cosa se pone fea.... Horas desesperadas repasa algunas de las inundaciones más devastadoras de la historia, como la de Río de Janeiro en Brasil, las de Luisiana en Estados Unidos, las de Hamburgo en Alemania, las de Uttarakhand en el norte de la India y el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: A veces, todo lo que se necesita es un movimiento bajo los pies.... Horas desesperadas examina las principales catástrofes geológicas, como las avalanchas de Afganistán, Pakistán, Nepal, Perú y Francia. También analiza desprendimientos geológicos en Filipinas, India y Colombia y un enorme socavón que consumió un estanque en Bosnia. También analiza las ventiscas en Estados Unidos, Israel y Reino Unido.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall
programme.desc: El cazador de ciervos Nathan Holcomb cae en picado desde su puesto en el árbol. La peor pesadilla de cualquier cazador se convierte en la realidad de Nathan. Con la espalda rota y paralizado, Nathan debe arrastrarse por su cuenta para encontrar ayuda.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: En lo que se considera una de las mayores historias de supervivencia del siglo XX, el marinero Steven Callahan se encuentra solo y a la deriva en una balsa salvavidas después de que su barco, el Napoleon Solo se hunda en pleno Atlántico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E10 - Adrift Part 2
programme.desc: Enfrentado al hambre, la deshidratación y los depredadores de las profundidades, el marinero Steven Callahan lucha por sobrevivir no sólo a las dificultades físicas, sino también a la tensión mental y emocional de estar a la deriva y solo en una balsa salvavidas que se desintegra.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E01 - Nightmare Canyon Part 1
programme.desc: El descenso de fin de semana de Justin y Jeremy Harris a un remoto cañón de Utah se convierte en una pesadilla de supervivencia cuando Justin se rompe gravemente una pierna. A medida que se acerca la noche y las temperaturas descienden por debajo del punto de congelación, ¿cómo sobrevivirán estos dos hermanos?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E01 - Rhino Wars
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective y cazador profesional de animales salvajes, le lleva al interior del África real, al frente de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: 經過幾年的努力，Keefer兄弟終於回到阿拉斯加的荒野，探索碎石路。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: 十多年之後，狂人山為兄弟們帶來了另一個開創性的成就。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E03 - S-Smart Terry
programme.desc: 給我一些糖，寶貝。特里穿越時間，測試受歡迎的《黑暗軍團》。特里不僅能測試幾個場景，還能與傳奇人物布魯斯·坎貝爾進行面對面的談話。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E04 - Terry's Brave Heart
programme.desc: 特里透過模仿《勇敢的心》中的威廉·華萊士來惹惱拉里。他不僅可以揮舞威廉爵士的劍，還說服拉里為他建造一座投石機。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E05 - Hyabusa
programme.desc: La misión japonesa de retorno de muestras de asteroides ha alcanzado su objetivo y está inspeccionando la roca espacial, lista para sumergirse y adquirir su muestra. El retorno a la Tierra de material procedente de asteroides ayudará a los científicos a desarrollar sistemas de defensa planetaria.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E06 - Fresh Eyes
programme.desc: Dos nuevos telescopios espaciales, Gaia y TESS, están en órbita con sus misiones principales llegando a su fin. A ellos se unirá el telescopio James Webb, y juntos abrirán un nuevo panorama en el tiempo y el espacio.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Nach den Anschlägen vom 11. September wurde die Militärpräsenz in New York und anderen amerikanischen Städten alltäglich, und den Antiterroreinheiten wurde praktisch ein "Blankoscheck" ausgestellt, wenn es darum ging, sicherzustellen, dass nie wieder ein Terroranschlag auf amerikanischem Boden stattfinden würde. Diese Folge von CQB wirft einen detaillierten Blick darauf, wer für die Besetzung von Elitepositionen in der Terrorismusbekämpfung ausgewählt wurde, wofür sie ausgebildet wurden und wie sie ausgerüstet waren: Wenn die gegnerischen Kräfte Verkehrsflugzeuge und chemische Waffen einsetzen, sind die Gegenmaßnahmen zwangsläufig kompliziert und vielfältig. CQB wirft einen intimen Blick darauf, wie es war, ein Beamter zu sein, der in Washington DC vor chemischen Angriffen gewarnt wurde, oder ein Reservist der Armee, der verdächtige Aktivitäten in den Straßen von New York City überwachte.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: Ningún otro país aparte de Francia cuenta con una fuerza militar de élite que invita a extranjeros a servir en sus filas. Con la reputación de ser un refugio seguro para individuos con pasados cuestionables, la Legión Extranjera Francesa es un verdadero ejército mercenario que se ha ganado un gran respeto dentro de la comunidad mundial de operaciones especiales. Este episodio de CQB examina una incursión de la Legión Extranjera en un pequeño aeropuerto de Irak durante la Guerra del Golfo de 1990, explorando la naturaleza de la Legión, en qué se diferencia de otras fuerzas especiales y cómo se prepara para una amplia variedad de escenarios de combate cuerpo a cuerpo en situaciones de conflicto en todo el mundo.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。

El retorno a la Tierra de material procedente de asteroides ayudará a los científicos a desarrollar sistemas de defensa planetaria.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E06 - Fresh Eyes
programme.desc: Dos nuevos telescopios espaciales, Gaia y TESS, están en órbita con sus misiones principales llegando a su fin. A ellos se unirá el telescopio James Webb, y juntos abrirán un nuevo panorama en el tiempo y el espacio.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E08 - Cubes
programme.desc: Los cubesats son satélites en miniatura que se han utilizado exclusivamente en órbita terrestre baja durante 15 años. Ahora, estos pequeños satélites están ganando popularidad y se utilizan también para misiones interplanetarias. Incluso se han enviado a Marte con la misión Insight, con la esperanza de comprender mejor el planeta rojo, nuestro sistema solar y más allá.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E13 - Hunt and Capture Saddam Hussein
programme.desc: Hace diez años, miles de efectivos de las fuerzas estadounidenses y de la Coalición, desde soldados de élite hasta reservistas, se encontraron en medio de dos conflictos que requerían un enfoque de la guerra totalmente distinto al que habían experimentado hasta entonces. Desde unidades de fuerzas especiales asegurando puntos vitales de interés estratégico y capturando a individuos clave en Afganistán. Este episodio de CQB analiza de cerca cómo se integraron las operaciones especiales en las unidades regulares y cómo lucharon en muchas situaciones de combate cuerpo a cuerpo con una combinación de inteligencia, armamento de alta tecnología y tecnologías de vigilancia para encontrar y capturar a Sadam Husein.

programme.title: Love on the Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

programme.title: The Love Advisor
programme.desc: Abby works as an assistant and writer of the popular podcast run by her former college friend Serena. Journalist comes from NYC to write about podcast and Serena. Abby starts to develop feelings, but Serena already has a plan for herself.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: 一位不喜愛旅行的記者追逐她夢寐以求的任務，在那裡她很快就成為一位渴望成為導遊的英俊B&B業主的導師。

programme.title: Danger on Party Island
programme.desc: 害羞的律師梅爾·戴爾在得知她勇敢的小妹妹突然去世後心碎。但當她出發去帶回妹妹的屍體時，她開始感覺到一些可疑的事情正在發生。而她可能成為下一個目標。

programme.title: Our Mother's Secret Affair
programme.desc: 黛安娜·帕克發現她家中的入侵者實際上是她的親生女兒，幾年前她將其交給了領養。當他們努力重建彼此的關係時，他們遇到了一個危險的威脅 - 一個無情的殺手，將不惜一切代價阻止他們重聚，即使這意味著謀殺。

programme.title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
programme.desc: 伊芙和朋友偷偷跑去參加派對，但朋友卻不幸喪命，而伊芙也失去了大學獎學金。很快，她找到一份工作以支付學費，但這份工作卻是導致她朋友死亡的危險伴遊計劃的掩護。

programme.title: Rear View Mirror
programme.desc: 一位年輕的母親試圖逃離她控制且虐待的丈夫，在一個理想化、寧靜的海灘小鎮開始新的生活。

programme.title: Danger on Party Island
programme.desc: 害羞的律師梅爾·戴爾在得知她勇敢的小妹妹突然去世後心碎。但當她出發去帶回妹妹的屍體時，她開始感覺到一些可疑的事情正在發生。而她可能成為下一個目標。

programme.title: Sparks Over Brooklyn
programme.desc: Single mom and chef Lidia sees her dreams for the future falling apart when arrogant tech innovator Danny buys her beloved family restaurant with plans to turn it into a busy dining experience.

programme.title: The Soulmate Search
programme.desc: When Lindsay gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They mutually agree this dating service has been a complete bust and make a deal to get their money back.

programme.title: Modeled with Love
programme.desc: 當模型製作人奧莉薇亞的父親準備從公司退休時，她認為自己理所當然會接管公司。然而，擁有全局思維的西蒙的出現，威脅到不僅是奧莉薇亞的舒適圈，還有她作為繼任者的角色。

programme.title: Danger on Party Island
programme.desc: 害羞的律師梅爾·戴爾在得知她勇敢的小妹妹突然去世後心碎。但當她出發去帶回妹妹的屍體時，她開始感覺到一些可疑的事情正在發生。而她可能成為下一個目標。

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: 當姊妹海倫娜和瑞秋對她們的愛情和工作感到厭倦時，她們同意交換住所兩周。然而，這場假期卻讓她們對工作、生活，最重要的是對戀愛有了全新的看法。

programme.title: Loving Every Minute
programme.desc: When Stephanie inherits a watch, she learns that it allows her to travel back in time five minutes, once a day. But as she uses it more and more, her life, and romance with her coworker Hunter, doesn't shake out the way she hoped.

programme.title: Mystery Island
programme.desc: 艾米莉亞·普里斯特利博士因需要放鬆的假期而前往神秘島，這是一個沉浸式的謀殺謎題主題度假村。遊戲開始時，悲劇發生了：度假村的隱士創始人被謀殺了。

programme.title: Stealing in Suburbia
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: 當一對夫婦無法決定婚禮主題時，他們雇了兩位婚禮策劃師，泰勒和本，讓他們透過提出兩種截然不同的風格來競爭這份工作。

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: When Emma, a baker in NYC, is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: 當薩馬維亞的皇子來到鎮上尋找皇室麵包師時，麵包師艾莉和瑪莉蓮的對抗更加激烈。當艾莉和皇子產生好感時，似乎他尋找的不僅僅是一個出色的蛋糕。

programme.title: Killer Queen Bee
programme.desc: 迪倫因為母親進入藥物依賴康復中心而轉學。與高中惡女蒂芬妮發生衝突後，蒂芬妮開始策劃讓迪倫的生活變得地獄般艱難。

programme.title: Just for Showmance
programme.desc: Follows Tara Thompson whose presenting career starts to stall, and agrees to go on a TV show to marry her 'perfect match', Joe, a man she's never met. But she secretly tries to track him down to clarify that the marriage is just for show.

programme.title: Falling for the Competition

programme.title: Dying for a Bid

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: 夏洛特和羅里是最好的朋友，為了慶祝他30歲生日，羅里去環遊世界。一年後，夏洛特去看了一位算命師，算命師告訴她她的命中註定是當羅里回來時和他在一起。羅里回來了……但他已經訂婚了。

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: 當一對夫婦無法決定婚禮主題時，他們雇了兩位婚禮策劃師，泰勒和本，讓他們透過提出兩種截然不同的風格來競爭這份工作。

programme.title: Love on the Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

programme.title: Behind the Wheel of Revenge
programme.desc: 金（Kim），大家都知道她是一名优秀的學生且人緣很好，但在一次家庭聚會上發生意外后，她陷入了大麻煩。她決定開車，卻不應該這樣做，結果失控撞車，甚至差點傷害到她的一位同班同學。這給她和舉辦派對的人的父母帶來了很多困擾。

programme.title: Sorority Secrets
programme.desc: 卡西(Cassie)非常高興加入一個精英姐妹會，作為年中轉校生，還享受免費住宿、學費援助以及出色的校友網絡。然而，當卡西發現姐妹會的會長和顧問正在與姐妹會的女孩們經營一個陪伴服務時，她意識到這個小秘密可能會要了她的命……

programme.title: Rear View Mirror

programme.title: A Bet with the Matchmaker

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: 當姊妹海倫娜和瑞秋對她們的愛情和工作感到厭倦時，她們同意交換住所兩周。然而，這場假期卻讓她們對工作、生活，最重要的是對戀愛有了全新的看法。
